evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule about game creation fields or forbids creating games; requirement is compatible with backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible constraint on invitation mechanism; compatible with other invite/limits stories.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No conflicting story prescribes an incompatible method for entering a round's item.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: This visibility requirement does not conflict with other stories' constraints.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule about selecting items.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding items is compatible with other stories; no conflicting constraint found.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items does not conflict with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story requires that items cannot be removed; deletion requirement is compatible.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This allows revealing estimates before all estimators have given them, which conflicts with PP-033's requirement that estimates be shown all at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible rule preventing accepting an average; compatible with other estimation flows.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automatic acceptance when all match is compatible with other stories about showing estimates simultaneously.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of agreed estimate does not conflict with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation capability is not incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories does not impose rules contradictory to other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: No incompatible constraints with other stories; complements import functionality.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is compatible with deletion/export stories; no direct contradictory rule.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is compatible with other stories; while anonymization for research exists (PP-052), that can be implemented as a separate anonymized store without making transcripts unavailable to moderators.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts does not inherently conflict with other constraints; anonymized research storage can coexist with export capability.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export is compatible with other requirements; anonymization for research can be a separate process.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Deletion capability does not conflict with other stories; other features can work around deletion (e.g., export prior to delete).

evaluations.evidence: create an account by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation fields do not conflict with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login mechanism is not in conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Updating account details does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is compatible with other stories; it may affect browsing/deletes but not inherently contradictory.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display requirement does not conflict with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password-reminder via email does not contradict other stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, ...} or {0, 1, 2, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Choice of card sets does not conflict with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: A maximum of 15 is not contradicted elsewhere; no conflicting cap is specified.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining via name entry is compatible with invitation mechanism and other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Viewing the current item is compatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: This visibility requirement is compatible with other features.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Showing submission presence (not the value) does not directly conflict with the simultaneous reveal requirement (PP-033); it can be implemented without revealing values early.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: As a requirement it is not internally inconsistent with other stories; the only conflicting story is PP-009 which allows early reveal (that story is flagged separately).

evaluations.evidence: be able to change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: This behavior is compatible with simultaneous reveal and change-until-last rules; no incompatible constraint found.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Storing and showing per-estimator prior estimates is not contradictory with other stories; anonymized research storage can still be provided separately (PP-052) so no clear incompatibility.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: This can be interpreted as showing identities and values at reveal time (for discussion) and does not necessarily force revealing before all estimates are given; no explicit incompatible rule found.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer capability does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset behavior is compatible with the shared timer story; no incompatible constraints present.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Browsing prior rounds' data does not conflict with deletion/export/etc.; no incompatible rule identified.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Fixed card ordering does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This rule about changing estimates is compatible with other estimation and reveal requirements.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying photos in the UI does not inherently conflict with the research requirement to store anonymized results (PP-052) because anonymized storage can be implemented separately.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance does not conflict with other functional or storage requirements.

evaluations.evidence: list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions is not incompatible with any other backlog story.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Performance optimization requirement does not contradict functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser support requirement does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is compatible with other requirements.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance expectation does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is not in conflict with other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design requirement does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page design does not contradict other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymized research storage can coexist with UI features that show identities (transcripts, thumbnails) by maintaining separate anonymized research dumps; no explicit incompatible constraint forces mutual exclusion.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics viewing is compatible with other stories; can be implemented using anonymized aggregates if needed.
